deviations.edit: Added 'zod.kit_last_scan' to RequiresClickhouse::CLICKHOUSE_TABLES_TO_TRUNCATE (tests/Concerns/RequiresClickhouse.php) — one line, outside t1's declared target_files.
deviations.why: The worker had used random_int() ids because that table is not truncated between CH test runs. Random ids make the suite non-deterministic and turn a collision into a confusing failure. Adding the table to the trait is what the trait exists for (a new CH table that tests write to), and it let the test use fixed, readable ids.

deviations.edit: Rewrote t1's test: fixed ids instead of random_int, and DB::table('kit_last_scan') instead of table('zod.kit_last_scan').
deviations.why: The hardcoded 'zod.' prefix in the test contradicted the exact rule enforced on the production class; and determinism. Re-verified red->green after the rewrite (naive select fails the collapse test, correct version passes 5/5).

deviations.edit: Trimmed OrgKitLastScanQuery's class docblock from 30 lines to 14.
deviations.why: Dalton finds heavy commentary overwhelming. Kept the three load-bearing facts (un-merged RMT -> max(); caller-supplied tenancy; scans_cold rejected at 9,586 MB) since each protects the design from being 'simplified' back into a defect, and dropped the rest.

deviations.edit: Fixed a silent-drop bug in OrgKitReportingStatusQuery: the bare array_filter() dropped any falsy mapping, so a kit whose kit_mapping is "0" would be removed before the query and read "not reporting" forever. Replaced with an explicit `$m !== ''` callback and added a regression test.
deviations.why: Reachable, not theoretical: production kit_type=1 mappings were measured at min length 1, with 280 of 3,535 all-digits. The failure mode is exactly the one this column exists to detect, and it is completely silent. Verified red->green (bare filter fails the new test).

deviations.edit: Removed config(['app.env' => 'local']) from t3's ClickHouse-outage test and documented why it must not come back.
deviations.why: That line silently DISARMED the guard the test exists to provide. PROVEN both ways: with ::handle() swapped to ::query() (the exact regression), the test FAILS without the line and PASSES with it. Forcing 'local' makes ClickhouseQuery::query() rethrow, so the resource's own catch yields 'Unknown' either way; leaving app.env at 'testing' lets query() swallow to [] and renders 'Never'/'Not Reporting', which is what the assertion must catch.

deviations.edit: Added the ticket's missing positive-path test (a kit with a recent scan AND a recent GPS fix renders the formatted timestamp and 'Reporting').
deviations.why: All 7 of t3's original tests asserted only Never/Unknown/Not Reporting, so the timezone + config('app.date_format') rendering path and the 'Reporting' state were both entirely untested on the ticket's primary column.

findings_fixed: claude2 M2 / claude1 L3 (test integrity, HIGH value): my own positive-path test built its fixture with now()->subHours(3), which re-expresses testNow in APP_TIMEZONE, then wrote it into a column the resource parses as UTC. PROVEN: under APP_TIMEZONE=America/Chicago the old fixture FAILS and the explicit-UTC replacement PASSES. phpunit.xml does not pin APP_TIMEZONE, so nothing guaranteed UTC.

claude3 L1 / claude1 M2 (AC-6 principle): a kit with an empty kit_mapping is never sent to ClickHouse, yet the UI rendered a definitive 'Not Reporting' — the same dishonesty the outage state exists to prevent. Now renders 'Unknown'; PROVEN by removing the guard (test fails).

claude1 L6 (observability regression): catching locally to enable the Unknown state bypassed ClickhouseQuery::query()'s report(), so an outage vanished from error tracking. Added report($e) beside the log, via a shared reportClickhouseFailure() helper.
claude3 M3 (silent footgun): OrgKitLastScanQuery defaulted a missing org_id to 0, matching nothing and rendering every row 'Never'. Now throws InvalidArgumentException, with a test.
claude1 L7 (signature that lies): once() memoizes by call site, not argument, so the helpers' $orgId parameter was ignored. Removed the parameter; the org is read from auth() inside.

RN=2, 3-LANE CONSENSUS (claude1 M1, claude2 M2, claude3 L1) — my RN=1 timezone fix was INCOMPLETE: I repaired one line and left the same anti-pattern in 12 other ClickHouse-insert fixtures, including three lines below my own warning comment. RN=2 claude3 H1 (High): OrgKitLastScanQuery aliased `toString(max(last_scan)) AS last_scan` — an aggregate onto its own source column, the exact shape TWO sibling classes' docblocks document as one ClickHouse rejects once anything else references the column. Renamed to `AS ts`, matching OrgLivePositionsQuery.

RN=2 claude1 L2: the org_id guard I added in RN=1 to make a wiring bug loud was immediately swallowed by my own catch(\Throwable) and rendered as 'Unknown'. InvalidArgumentException now re-throws; only genuine ClickHouse failures degrade.

RN=4 claude2 M2 / claude3 M1 — I WAS WRONG, and this is the most important correction of the run. In RN=1 I accepted a lane's claim that once() keys only on call site, removed $orgId from all three helpers, and wrote that premise into a docblock as fact. VERIFIED against vendor/laravel/framework Onceable::hashFromTrace(): it maps over (new ReflectionClosure($callable))->getClosureUsedVariables() and folds them into the hash, so `use ($orgId)` DOES key the memo — as sibling UsersResource.php:253 already demonstrated. Reverted to org-keyed closures, deleted the false docblock. Exposure was LATENT (classic FrankenPHP, one auth per request) but goes live under worker mode, a queued job iterating orgs, or a two-user test.

RN=4 claude2 M1 — the auth gate and cross-org isolation tests were behind a class-level RequiresClickhouse, which skips unless CLICKHOUSE_DRIVER=clickhouse — the documented LOCAL DEFAULT. REPRODUCED: 10 skipped / 0 assertions / exit 0, so deleting canAccess() or the org_id scope stayed green for most developers and would in CI too if the CH service failed. Split the 5 ClickHouse-free guarantees into GlKitsResourceAccessTest (no trait). VERIFIED: they now run with CH absent (5 passed, 12 assertions) instead of skipping.

RN=4 claude1 M1 / claude3 L2 — toString() renders in the ClickHouse SERVER timezone while the consumer hard-parses UTC. Measured this server as UTC (no live impact), but made it unconditional: toString(max(...), 'UTC') in both queries.

RN=5 claude2 M1 — my RN=4 UTC fix was HALF a fix: I made the toString() RENDER timezone-explicit and left the FILTER comparing a bare string, which ClickHouse resolves against a DateTime column in the SERVER timezone, sliding the 14-day boundary by the server offset. Now bound through toDateTime(?, 'UTC'). Third time this run I was caught shipping an instance fix for a class problem.

RN=5 claude1 M2 / claude2 M2 — the tenant-keyed memo I restored in RN=4 had NO test: deleting `use ($orgId)` left the suite green. Added test_two_orgs_rendered_in_one_process_do_not_share_a_memoized_map, which renders org A (populating the memo), then org B in the same process and asserts B sees its own rows and its own timestamp. Mechanism proven independently: once(fn() use ($x)) with x=1 then x=2 returns 1 then 2, so captured vars ARE hashed.
RN=5 claude1 L2 — @return array<string, string> was wrong: PHP casts all-numeric mapping keys to int. Corrected to array<array-key, string>.

ac.evidence: /app/gl-kits renders under the Reports nav group and lists exactly the org's 4 kit_type=1 kits; the kit_type=2 kit (QA-NOT-GL) is excluded.

Headers are exactly Kit / Company Owner / Last Scan Received / Reporting (14d). Company Owner = 'QA GL Kits Org' on every row; QA-GL-REPORTING shows 'Aug 31, 2026 12:25 PM CDT'. Backend B3 returned 3 last-scan rows for org 5.

Org 6's GL kit (QA-OTHER-ORG-GL) never appears (4 of 4 results). A9: QA-GL-REPORTING shows its org-5 timestamp (12:25 PM), not the NEWER org-6 tenancy-trap row (1:47 PM) that a missing org_id predicate would surface via max().

QA-GL-REPORTING = Reporting (GPS fix inside 14d); QA-GL-STALE = Not Reporting (only fix is 20 days old). B4 resolved exactly 1 mapping, with the UPPERCASE sc_positions row folding into the same lowercase key.

QA-GL-NEVER (no scan row, no GPS) renders 'Never' + 'Not Reporting' with no error or blank cell. Measured as the common case, not an edge case: only ~21% of production GL kits have ever appeared in sc_positions.

QA-GL-NOMAPPING renders 'Unknown', not 'Not Reporting'. All three states are distinct by colour AND icon (green check / amber question / gray x) — verified by the driver on the screenshot, not just reported. NOTE: this covers the no-mapping path; the ClickHouse-OUTAGE path is pinned by an automated test but is deferred to human QA step ec-2 for visual confirmation.
